Propose practical technical solutions rather than relying on customers or developers to determine how the integration should work.
Translate business integration needs into clear and actionable technical specifications that development teams can build from.
Collaborate with engineering, implementation, QA, and client teams throughout delivery to clarify requirements and protect the integrity of the integration design.
Support integration validation and troubleshooting when necessary.
Work across multiple systems, customers, and projects and adapt quickly to changing technical contexts

La persona che cerchiamo è specializzata nell'analisi, nella mappatura e nel miglioramento dei processi aziendali in ambito sanitario.
